name: Contract Desk
tagline: A weekly view of the legal paper: terms extracted, stalled reviews flagged
description: Gives one weekly view of everything currently in legal paper: contracts summarized by stage and owner, the key terms pulled into one place, and any review that has stalled highlighted before it becomes a launch blocker. The stack of agreements stops being an unreadable folder.
